	}
}

COLDWAR_AP_reduce_political = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political = -1 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_cooldown days = 90 }
		COLDWAR_AP_refresh = yes
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political < 4 } }

		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_cooldown days = 90 }
		COLDWAR_AP_refresh = yes
	}
}

				limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_colonial_or_minority = yes }

					limit = { NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF NOT = { has_war_with = SAF } } } }
